title_block.title: ProComm AUDIO-8X8 - TDM, Clock, and Control Interface

comment.value: Four terminated LVDS receivers carry MCLK, BCLK, FSYNC, and DAC TDM data

100 ohm differential; interleaved returns; no branch stubs

AVDD=5.0 V, TVDD=3.3 V, internal 1.8 V LDO enabled

title_block.title: ProComm AUDIO-8X8 - Eight Balanced Input Channels

comment.value: THAT1206 -6 dB receiver; OPA1652 single-supply differential ADC driver
+4 dBu nominal, +24 dBu maximum, no phantom power
13 k/1 k network maps +24 dBu to 2.49 Vpp differential at AK5558
Protection and filter values require simulation plus surge/RFI bench qualification

title_block.title: ProComm AUDIO-8X8 - Eight Balanced Output Channels

comment.value: AK4458 datasheet PCM LPF: 3.9 k, 4.7 k, 150 R, 470 pF, 3.9 nF
OPA1652 gain stage and THAT1646 active-balanced line driver
TQ2-12V DPDT relays short both XLR legs to AGND while de-energized
+24 dBu into 600 ohm is a qualification target; simulation and bench release required

title_block.title: ProComm AUDIO-8X8 - Local Power, Sequencing, and Ground Star

comment.value: AUDIO_12V is the only carrier power input; local 3 A fuse and one GND-to-AGND star
TRI 20-1223 creates +/-15 V; TPS62913 creates the quiet 5.5 V pre-rail
Separate LT3045 5 V/300 mA rails feed ADC and DAC; TPS7A2033 feeds AKM digital I/O
Power-good, sequencing, thermal rise, ripple, and conducted-emissions tests gate release
